featured_reviews.name: Tejasvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
On 31st March, during my engagement, I had a very good experience with CamLens Photography & Films
However, I got raw photos without any editing or filters—it was so raw that I could have clicked similar pictures with my mobile. For the videos, I had to explain over a hundred times the type of edited video I wanted, but even after all that, the final edited video left me unsatisfied.
When we later started discussing our wedding packages, we mentioned that last time we didn’t ask for a discount but expected one this time. At that point, he began arguing, saying that he had given us a fair price and package last time, and went on about how busy he was and the number of shoots he had on our engagement day. We had only asked for a good discount this time, but he started justifying the packages he gave us last time instead of focusing on our wedding package that we asked him for.
Like this is way you talk to you client l??
Don't tell us how much work quantity you have show us your quality work
Just because you have so many shoots so client has to tell you 100 times that how they need their photo and videos
Stop getting obsessed with yourself and concentrate on quality and give quality results to clients
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
However, we strongly disagree with the claims mentioned, as they are misleading and do not reflect the actual services delivered.

Firstly, no “raw” or unedited photos were delivered. All images shared were properly processed and color-corrected as per our standard workflow. Comparing professional work to mobile photography is completely unfair and incorrect.

Secondly, regarding the video, multiple revisions were already provided from our end. Despite accommodating repeated changes and detailed inputs, it is unreasonable to claim that your requirements were ignored.

Your statement about having to “explain 100 times” is highly exaggerated. Our team remained patient and responsive throughout, even with continuously changing expectations.

As for the pricing discussion, we clearly explained our package value and maintained transparency. Expecting additional discounts does not justify misrepresenting past work or communication.

We take our quality and client relationships seriously, but we will not accept false or exaggerated statements that damage our reputation.

— Team CamLens Photography & Films

featured_reviews.name: Nita Shelar
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent work done by Divyesh and team! Thank you for beautifully capturing our precious wedding moments. Your attention to detail and willingness to go the extra mile truly made a difference. I deeply appreciate your professionalism, positive attitude, and expertise in photography and cinematography. Always on time, with super‑good services, you ensured everything went smoothly. Your outstanding work made our occasion a grand success, and these memories will be cherished forever.

featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Thombare
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been taking photos at Chhaya Studio since I was 12 years old. Now, my daughter has also had her photos taken there. It has been a wonderful experience over the years. Thank you, Chhaya Studio, for your excellent service, timely delivery, and prompt assistance whenever needed. Thanks again!
